{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Identify the QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Count them
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Filter out QA orders and count completed orders in the remaining data
real_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] != '999999.99']
completed_real = real_orders[real_orders['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]

print(f"Completed orders among real orders: {completed_real}")"}
